features: Join several leagues at once; manage them in the new Leagues window
The League button shows the league you are racing in
Update window now shows what's new in the release
improvements: Reports, overlay and main window now use neutral wording: contributing factors and contribution share instead of fault and verdict
Incident report adds Analysis limits to the Incident assessment
One set of measured facts per incident: speed at contact, braking and impact numbers now match across the whole report
The other car is now confirmed by the incident points the sim awards, so the right driver is named in crowded packs
Normal braking by the car ahead (e.g. into a corner) is no longer mistaken for an abrupt stop; only violent deceleration counts
Reports no longer quote a speed for the other car at the moment of contact
Speed at contact is now read just before the impact, so it no longer reflects the crash itself
Reports can flag a possible dive-bomb when the contact happened on the inside of the corner
More reliable estimate of the other car's speed; reports flag when the other car was identified with low certainty
When there is not enough data to assess an incident, the report says so instead of showing a contribution share
League invite codes now accept any code with 6 to 24 letters, numbers or hyphens (e.g. K7Q4-X9P2)
Invite codes are converted to uppercase and spaces are removed automatically
